context: Tests whether the agent creates a correctly structured modular Makefile system for a new project with multiple concern domains and subcommands, following naming, help, and delegation conventions.

checklist.name: .DEFAULT_GOAL set
checklist.description: Root Makefile contains `.DEFAULT_GOAL := help` so bare `make` shows help

checklist.name: Domain modules included
checklist.description: Root Makefile includes domain modules from mk/ (e.g. `include mk/test.mk`, `include mk/lint.mk`, `include mk/build.mk`)

checklist.name: mk/ modular files
checklist.description: Separate .mk files exist under mk/ for each concern domain (test, lint, build)

checklist.name: Domain subdirectory Makefiles
checklist.description: Each multi-subcommand domain has its own Makefile inside a subdirectory (e.g. mk/test/Makefile, mk/lint/Makefile, mk/build/Makefile)

checklist.name: filter-out delegation
checklist.description: Domain .mk files use `$(MAKE) -C mk/<domain> $(filter-out $@,$(MAKECMDGOALS))` to pass subcommands through

checklist.name: Catch-all rule
checklist.description: Domain .mk files include a catch-all `%: @:` rule to prevent 'No rule to make target' errors for subcommand arguments

checklist.name: Script delegation
checklist.description: Recipe lines invoke scripts (e.g. `@./scripts/test-unit.sh`) rather than containing inline bash logic

checklist.name: @ prefix on recipes
checklist.description: All recipe lines use `@` prefix to suppress command echoing

checklist.name: Lowercase hyphenated names
checklist.description: All target names are lowercase; multi-word targets use hyphens (not underscores or camelCase)

checklist.name: Domain help behavior
checklist.description: Bare `make test` (and `make lint`, `make build`) shows subcommand help rather than running a default action — confirmed by make-test-help-output.txt and make-lint-help-output.txt
